data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to detect object edges, scan paper, and crop images.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that detects edges of objects, scans paper, and detects rectangles or corners using native libraries. It allows users to crop the detected object image and returns the file path of the cropped result.
use_when: You need document scanning functionality in your app.
You want to automatically detect edges and crop scanned paper images.
avoid_when: You only need basic image picking without edge detection.
You require cross-platform support beyond Android and iOS.
strengths: Provides live camera edge detection and gallery selection.
Uses robust native implementations (WeScan and SmartPaperScan).
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration for native iOS and Android build requirements (such as minimum SDK and Kotlin/Podfile setups).
Limited platform support (only Android and iOS).
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minimum iOS version to 13+, adding camera and photo library permissions in Info.plist, configuring Podfile for WeScan, and updating Android minimum SDK to 21 and Kotlin version to 1.8.0.
